requirements.title: Define the learner and observable outcome
Define data custody and network behavior

cases.name: Preserve and identify the foundation
preconditions: Immutable base commit 3a47ea48da53cb9de3ff4727ca5f0f0b6f2b9bf8 with tree f365fbefcea6dcf65dbb970b9640f5073154cfde.
Verify qa/source-hashes.json SHA-256 equals 60c3ecb36c24512d6b390b94ae504dffba244f1d41f1ce7367afb6ab00126bd8 before trusting its entries.
steps: Resolve the immutable base commit/tree and verify the source receipt digest. Fail before further checks on identity mismatch.
Compare all43 source receipt entries against course/ and dist/course/.
Compare dist/content.json and dist/course.zip with the immutable base hashes.
expected: All86 source copies and both protected content/archive files match the anchored hashes; changing the receipt cannot establish a new baseline.

cases.name: Define the learner and observable outcome
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Use P00 to inspect prerequisite feedback and read a later lesson without completing prerequisites.
Attempt to award intermediate status using only progress clicks or a finished job.
expected: Read-ahead works; missing prerequisites are explicit; navigation/job completion never yields competency or independent-review status.

cases.name: Ship a finite content expansion
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Compile content and enumerate P00,00-20,E01,E02 with every required section and exercise.
Remove one answer or destination module in a test fixture and rerun compilation.
expected: All24 listed modules ship (21 numbered +P00+2 electives); incomplete content compilation fails and no placeholder satisfies a module.

cases.name: Support two honest product modes
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Open fresh static mode in each required browser, inspect requests and controls, and navigate all primary routes.
Attempt to activate the unavailable live execution controls.
expected: No localhost probe or private-network request occurs; live controls explain local setup and cannot create jobs; reader/calculations/recorded imports still work.

cases.name: Qualify named execution profiles
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Run preflight under each selected runtime profile, recording exact environment/hardware.
Select CUDA while unavailable and verify no automatic CPU substitution.
expected: Receipt meets named profile conditions; unavailable CUDA gives a documented preflight error and no job/device fallback.

cases.name: Select supported model and operations
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Prepare the pinned model explicitly and enumerate runtime operations and effects.
Attempt unknown model ID, mismatched tokenizer and missing checkpoint; inspect whether a fallback is used.
expected: Only pinned model assets and named operation effects are allowed; unsupported identities fail without substitution or unintended training.

cases.name: Keep the implementation bounded
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Inventory routes/API/package capabilities against the exclusion list.
Submit a request for arbitrary model URL, shell execution or public bind and inspect rejection.
expected: Excluded functions are absent; unsupported request shapes do not execute or cause filesystem changes.

cases.name: Add explicit implementation paths
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Compare delivered source tree to the target path/responsibility table.
Compile applied content and compare each lesson source digest with its output; inject duplicate and broken-link fixtures.
expected: Source changes stay in allowed target areas; protected course files untouched; each malformed compiler fixture fails before output publication.

cases.name: Define data custody and network behavior
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Capture network requests during fresh static/local navigation and later offline lessons.
Render inert markup in imported notes/results and inspect source labels.
expected: No unsolicited external request occurs; imported markup remains inert text and imported results retain imported provenance.

cases.name: Separate implementation, evidence, and qualification
preconditions: Freeze implementation commit and applicable profile receipt.
steps: Join all requirement/case/profile/browser records for one candidate.
Change one required case to BLOCKED and inspect the release summary and historical baseline labels.
expected: All statuses remain stage-specific; one BLOCKED mandatory case prevents completion and previous36-test evidence is not assigned to new features.

cases.name: Authenticated local mode and connection loss
preconditions: Frozen candidate, isolated storage and profile receipt; native browser available when method is browser.
steps: Pair local mode and complete authenticated preflight.
Disconnect the service while a job is active, reload the same tab, restart/re-pair and reconcile.
expected: Live actions require the authenticated compatible service and selected valid inputs; stale display does not infer completion or duplicate job submission.

cases.name: Real operation and model preparation boundaries
preconditions: Frozen candidate, isolated storage and profile receipt; native browser available when method is browser.
steps: Submit unauthenticated then authenticated preflight/job requests.
Invoke model_prepare with explicit acceptance; verify allowlisted downloads, identity and offline reuse.
expected: Unauthorized request creates no job; authenticated operations retain process/job/checkpoint identity; only declared safe model bytes are downloaded; imports never gain local execution attestation.

cases.name: Preserved Python lab regression execution
preconditions: Frozen candidate, isolated storage and profile receipt; native browser available when method is browser.
steps: Run unchanged canonical lab test entrypoints from the protected course on the selected profile.
Run tiny-v2 parity controls without modifying legacy assertions.
expected: Legacy and parity outputs are retained separately; all required assertions pass; no changed baseline file or weakened test satisfies the case.
